column5: <evidence>. tools/split.py reads the first three.
body is only EnsureRegistered/RunStaticInit calls for ~160 Alchemy engine classes (igExternalImageEntry..igCommonTraversal); main calls it once after igObjectSystem_Acquire

compiler-emitted deleting destructor of main's scope guard (unit-objects __dt__5GuardFv): its only work is igObjectSystem_Release, pairing the igObjectSystem_Acquire(0xc80) just before the guard is constructed
returns the built-in engine ini text ("[CORE]\nintrinsicModulePath = MODULES ... [MEMORYPOOLS] ..."); its only caller passes it to igObjectSystem_SetIniText
igObjectSystem_SetIniText(GameMain_GetIniText()) when non-null; first call in main

thread entry (passed to igThread by 0x259b60): endless loop opening "atstream:!-5150", reading an 8-byte header and a text body, publishing it in g_atstreamText/g_atstreamTextReady and acknowledging with "a"
creates an igThread, sets stack 0x2000, entry GameMain_AtstreamThread (0x259a60), priority 0xff and starts it
g_atfilePrefixSet = (igPsx2_SetAtfilePrefix(argv[0]) == success); main calls it with argv[0]
starts the atstream thread (0x259b60) when g_atfilePrefixSet; called once from main
when g_atfilePrefixSet: optionally sleeps the current thread 1,000,000, and when g_atstreamTextReady hands g_atstreamText to 0x259dc0, then clears the ready/full-reload flags; polled by the game loop

replaces the viewer file-name list (+40, new igStringRefList) with the interned text and the per-file int list (+36, new igIntList) with [g_defaultNameValue], reloads (0x25a550) and, when asked, igViewerSceneInfoManager_ResetView

the scene-load step between clearing and framing: GameMain_ReloadScene is GameMain_ClearScene then this, and GameMain_RunGame/RunBenchmark run ViewerSetup_Open, this, ViewerSetup_ResetView; its body only reads the viewer's model-name list (+40), the loading it guarded compiled out of the retail build; alt GameMain_LoadModels
retaining assignment of the two app lists into the viewer: +40 (file names, igStringRefList) and +36 (igIntList); main passes the app object fields after argv parsing

constructor of the game viewer object main keeps on the stack (unit-objects __ct__3BlkFv): Viewer_CreateDisplay, reference members, igFolder "cdrom0:", igViewerLoadingFileMessage, then the .igb listing 0x25ac60
deleting destructor of that viewer object (unit-objects __dt__3BlkFv): releases its seven references, viewer teardown 0x463910, frees for a positive flag; convention <C>_Destroy
GameMain_ClearScene then 0x259f80 on the viewer; called after GameMain_ReplaceSceneFile installs a new file list

the normal main loop (main picks it unless the benchmark option byte +216 is set): resets frame options, registers the Bec/Ndmw/Lua/AdxMovie classes, sets beSystem next file "ndmw.igb", loops update/render/poll until quit
benchmark loop: hides GUI/bounding box/normals, runs warm-up frames, times N frames with an igTimer and reports "average frame rate over %d frames : %f fps"
fills the viewer list +48 from the folder (+52) listing, strips the last two characters (";1" ISO version) of each name and removes names without the "igb" extension

tears the loaded scene down: 0x463c80, scene traversal and visual-context resets through igViewerSceneInfoManager, recreates the Enbaya/animation pools, resets the User1 allocator; run before loading the next beSystem file and at shutdown
